final_domain_guard: The working draft removed the old mapped-branch guard too broadly. A translated parabola has in-domain endpoints, out-of-domain midpoint and nevertheless received a whole-surface image certificate. The witness fails in native-domain-missing.log before the fix. BRep now retains prior refusal of rational maps and admits a transformed branch only for the exact unit-square source exchange; Hypercurve polynomial identities remain geometric proofs rather than bounded UV-domain proofs.
